# Exercício 1

```{r}
library(readr)

cadastro <- read_delim(
  "dados/cadastro.csv",
  delim = ";",
  locale = locale(
    decimal_mark = ".",
    encoding = "ISO-8859-1"
  ),
  na = "",
  col_types = cols(
    codigo = col_character(),
    nome = col_character(),
    padrao = col_character(),
    quartos = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diarias_2023 <- read_delim(
  "dados/diarias_2023.csv",
  delim = ";",
  locale = locale(
    decimal_mark = ".",
    encoding = "US-ASCII"
  ),
  na = "-",
  col_types = cols(
    codigo = col_character(),
    jan = col_double(),
    fev = col_double(),
    mar = col_double(),
    abr = col_double(),
    mai = col_double(),
    jun = col_double(),
    jul = col_double(),
    ago = col_double(),
    set = col_double(),
    out = col_double(),
    nov = col_double(),
    dez = col_double()
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

```

# Exercício 2

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)

meses <- c(
  "jan", "fev", "mar", "abr", "mai", "jun",
  "jul", "ago", "set", "out", "nov", "dez"
)

diarias_2023_long <- diarias_2023 |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(meses),
    names_to = "mes",
    values_to = "diarias"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mes = factor(mes, levels = meses)
  )

n_linhas <- nrow(diarias_2023_long)
n_ausentes <- sum(is.na(diarias_2023_long$diarias))

n_linhas
n_ausentes

```
